verdict: Organic search is holding; paid ads are off and calls remain low.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came entirely from your Google Business profiles — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran no spend and produced no leads this period. Your three profiles combined for 174 actions, with direction requests the clearest sign of local intent, but only 8 of those visits turned into phone calls, a conversion rate that remains too low. Profile visibility appears healthy enough to drive people to your listings, but something between the listing and the call is breaking down, and we're reviewing profile content and call prompts to close that gap. Over the last few days, organic action volume has dipped to near zero, which we're watching closely going into next week.

highlights.phrase: total actions from organic local search this period — directions, web clicks, and calls combined
phone calls received across all three profiles this period, against 140 direction requests
week-over-week increase in Google Business profile activity, the one positive directional signal

watch_item.issue: Call volume is critically low relative to the number of people requesting directions — intent is there but it is not converting to calls.
watch_item.fix: Profile content and call-to-action prompts are being reviewed this week to reduce friction between a listing view and an inbound call.
